subject: english
question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Cunning
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cunning** means having or showing skill in achieving one's ends by deceit or evasion. (चालाकी)

 
 
• **Example:** The **cunning **fox managed to escape from the hunters.
 
 
 
• **Simple** means easily understood or done; presenting no difficulty; plain or unadorned. (सरल)
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were written in **simple** language, making them easy to follow.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Simple**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings:

 
• **Oblique** (तिरछा): neither parallel nor at a right angle to a specified or implied line; slanting.

 
 
• **Example:** The sunlight came through the window in oblique rays.
 
 
 
• **Stealthy** (गुप्त): behaving, done, or made in a cautious and surreptitious manner, so as not to be seen or heard.
 
 
• **Example:** The cat made a stealthy approach towards the bird.
 
 
 
• **Guileful** (कपटपूर्ण): deceitfully cunning or tricky.
 
 
• **Example:** The guileful merchant tricked customers into buying fake gems.
